verdict.line: You lose by getting poked down with Q (Blinding Dart) and E (Toxic Shot) autos while he walks away on W (Move Quick) before level 6; you win by living to 6, then landing E (Hookshot) into R (The Hextech Ultimatum) with your jungler to force a melee fight he can't kite out of.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire win condition is closing distance and connecting an auto-attack-based combo (Q, on-hit from passive, R bonus magic damage), but Teemo's kit is built to prevent exactly that: Q (Blinding Dart) blinds her the moment she commits, E (Toxic Shot) ticks poison for free while he kites on W (Move Quick), and R (Noxious Trap) mushrooms can zone the wall or brush she needs for E (Hookshot). Her only real answer is the level 6 power spike, where R anchors him in melee and removes his kiting.

theirWindow.when: His Q (Blinding Dart) is up, you're overextended
theirWindow.what: Don't commit E (Hookshot) or walk up for a Q (Precision Protocol) auto here — if he blinds you on engage your attacks deal no damage and he just kites off on W (Move Quick) while E (Toxic Shot) ticks poison for free.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, his Q down, jungler nearby
yourWindow.what: Dash in with R (The Hextech Ultimatum) to anchor him in place, then follow with E (Hookshot) off a wall for the knockup and W (Tactical Sweep) for the slow and heal — he physically cannot kite out of the anchored zone, which is the one window the lane data says to use (OP.GG explicitly calls for a jungler gank here).

powerCurve.note: free poke from Q/E, no answer yet
W punishes overextension if he misreads range
full mushroom coverage zones your engage

start.why: 44.7% win rate over 1074 games at 79.2% pick — the sustain directly offsets the free poke from his Q (Blinding Dart) damage and E (Toxic Shot) on-hit before you have any way to punish him.

boots.why: 47% win rate over 1027 games at 82.6% pick — the magic resist blunts his poison ticks and the tenacity cuts the slow duration from his R (Noxious Trap) mushroom fields.

core.why: First item on the 57.4% win-rate path over 195 games — the stats scale your auto-reset trade pattern once you can actually land hits.
Second item on the same build path — sustain and cleave for extended duels once you've anchored him with R.
Most-picked third item (30.6% pick) on the 57.4% win-rate path — bleed damage over time lets you survive his poison DoT stacking during the all-in.

situational.when: you're ahead and need to survive extended skirmishes after you've already committed R
you're falling behind on poison/magic damage and need the shield plus magic resist
you're snowballing and want the cooldown reduction to loop Q (Precision Protocol) and E (Hookshot) faster in skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustains you through his free ranged poke on every passing proc, which matters most before level 6 when you have no answer to his damage.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest win rate (47.4%) and most-picked combo (58.9%) — Ignite punishes the all-in window once R (The Hextech Ultimatum) anchors him and he can't heal or kite the kill away.

playing.title: Track his Blinding Dart before committing
playing.detail: If his Q (Blinding Dart, 8s cooldown) is up, do not walk up for a trade or commit E (Hookshot) — getting blinded on engage removes your entire auto-based damage plan.

playing.title: Hold E for all-in, not poke
playing.detail: E (Hookshot) is a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown wall-leap — whiffing it to poke burns your only hard engage for a full lane rotation, so save it for a real all-in near usable terrain.

playing.title: Punish overextension with delayed W
playing.detail: W (Tactical Sweep) only lands if he doesn't see the cast delay coming — throw it when he's pushed past the point he can walk out of the cone, since the outer half slows and heals you.

playing.title: All-in at 6 with your jungler
playing.detail: R (The Hextech Ultimatum) anchors him in a zone he can't leave — this is the single biggest swing in the matchup and OP.GG's own data calls for exactly this: wait for your jungler to gank and convert the kill.

playing.title: Oracle Lens before pushing
playing.detail: His R (Noxious Trap) mushrooms are placed instantly (1s cooldown, 230 range) and are invisible until triggered — sweep brush and chokepoints before you commit to an all-in path.

playing.title: Don't duel into his Move Quick window
playing.detail: W (Move Quick) gives him passive bonus movement speed until he's hit — if he's actively kiting at range, close the gap fast or disengage rather than chasing a losing race.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Doran’s Shield and use [W] to mitigate some of the damage Teemo deals. We recommend waiting for your jungler to gank to get a kill! Use Oracle Lens to avoid stepping on mushrooms when engaging!
